_doc: Controlled --wal-shards ladder to find the optimal wal config on real NVMe (c4d-standard-16-lssd, Titanium local SSD). Isolates shard count as the ONLY variable: server pinned to 8 vCPU (headroom so CPU is never the limit — prior telemetry showed wal at ~1.3 busy cores, fsync-bound + CPU-idle) and worker-threads fixed at 8. Sweeps shards 1/4/8/16/24 at 200k streams (matches the documented s16 reference point). Each config emits SRV_STATS (cpu_cores/inflight/durwait) + WAL_CKPT so we can see fsync-lane saturation directly. The pod ladder over-provisions offered load so even the highest-ceiling shard config saturates; the barrier-aligned walker auto-stops each config at its plateau (plateau_pct 8, patience 2). Resumable per cell (cells.json), so an interrupted run resumes without recompute.
